name: free
contract: deallocate: records (pointer, capacity, 0) in call order

name: unwrap
contract: Result::unwrap panic; the Location/vtable pair (rcx, r8) names the site

name: resume
contract: unwind landing pad call, never reached on a normal return

name: format
contract: path formatter: writes {capacity, pointer, length}; entry argument recorded

name: read
contract: file read: writes {capacity or 1<<63, pointer or error, length}

name: path
contract: aws_name path builder 0x1772fa0: writes {capacity, pointer, length}

name: string
contract: JSON string parser: writes {tag, pointer, length}; tag 2 is an error

name: classify
contract: resolves to the plain classifier 0x1775500 and runs real

name: error_new
contract: serde error constructor: records the code word, returns a 0x28 byte box

name: document
contract: document reader: writes the tag byte, the value byte or an error box

name: unknown_variant
contract: unknown-variant error: records (pointer, length, table, count)

name: invalid_type
contract: invalid-type error: records the expectation pointer

name: position
contract: attaches the reader position to an error
